title: 池上二绝 二
author: 白居易
prompt:

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Specific scene: A small child returning in a tiny punt with a few green lotus seedpods, an unmistakable narrow trail opened through floating duckweed behind the boat. Summer pond intimacy and innocent secrecy, no adult scolding scene.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 池上二绝 二 — 白居易
小娃撑小艇，偷采白莲回。
不解藏踪迹，浮萍一道开。
